description: This Java class defines AttractionsGridPagerAdapter, a custom adapter for a GridViewPager in an Android Wear app, managing attraction images, descriptions, and actions for a tourist attractions UI.

classes.name: AttractionsGridPagerAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter for displaying attractions in a grid pager, handling images, descriptions, and actions, with fade-in/out UI effects.

classes.name: DelayedHide
classes.description: Helper class to manage delayed hiding and showing of UI elements with fade animations.

methods.name: AttractionsGridPagerAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing context and attractions data.

methods.name: setInsets
methods.description: Sets UI insets for layout adjustments.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns number of rows based on attractions list.

methods.name: getColumnCount
methods.description: Returns fixed number of columns in grid.

methods.name: instantiateItem
methods.description: Creates and returns view for each grid cell based on attraction data and column type.

methods.name: getBackgroundForPage
methods.description: Provides background drawable for each page, typically attraction image.

methods.name: destroyItem
methods.description: Removes view and cancels hide animations.

methods.name: isViewFromObject
methods.description: Checks if view corresponds to object.

methods.name: onPageScrolled
methods.description: No implementation, placeholder for page scroll events.

methods.name: onPageSelected
methods.description: No implementation, placeholder for page selection events.

methods.name: onPageScrollStateChanged
methods.description: Triggers UI fade effects on page scroll state change.

methods.name: startAction
methods.description: Executes attraction-related actions via Wear Message API and confirmation animation.

methods.name: getStartActionClickListener
methods.description: Creates click listener to start attraction actions.

methods.name: setOnChromeFadeListener
methods.description: Sets listener for fade in/out UI effects.
